title: lastreopsis exculta
intro: Lastreopsis exculta, commonly known as the Exculted Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastreopsis exculta include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Lastreopsis exculta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
